title: Bruce Leuchter:
title_short: Bruce Leuchter · Not a Seizure Medicine
headline: The head of a drug company says, in his own words, that families lead this work.
story: Bruce Leuchter is the CEO of GRIN Therapeutics. He says the company does not see its medicine as a seizure medicine. It is for the disorder itself. Then he speaks to every parent. For donors and partners this is proof that CureGRIN is a real partner of industry. It is not about trial dates, new trials or how the medicine works.

Loops: L1 “Then what is it?” opens 0:00 and closes at 0:04. L2 “Why does a drug company CEO say this to parents?” opens 0:00 and closes in the button. Stakes: today there is no treatment made for this disorder. Families wait.
